Commentary.Commentary: That's the end! England might have won the series but we all know both teams are playing for the big cause. Australia will look for a morale-boosting win in the last match while England will look to clean-sweep. The 3rd T20I is on the 14th of this month. Join us at 1.40 pm IST (8.10 am GMT) and earlier for the build up. Till then, cheers!

Dawid Malan is the Player of the Match for his match-winning performance. He says It is always good to score runs and get away with a win. States he did not have a great Big Bash but it helped him learn. He hopes he can keep scoring runs.

Jos Buttler, the skipper of England says they showed great character and Dawid Malan was brilliant. Adds Malan has been consistent and he has done it far too consistently. Mentions Sam Curran wants to be there during the tough moments and he bowled brilliantly to Tim David who is tough to bowl.

Aaron Finch, the skipper of Australia says the fielding was the difference. States they were sloppy after taking 4 early wickets. Credits Tim David and says the more he plays, the more he'll learn. Adds Josh Hazlewood is as good as anyone with the new ball and they can bowl whenever the team wants.
...Presentation coming up...

Australia lost too many wickets earlier on. Maxwell, Warner and Finch failed to contribute a lot. Marsh and Stoinis then revived the innings. Stoinis fell but Marsh continued with David. There was a time when Australia were on top but wickets at regular intervals just kept making it tough for them and in the end, they fell short. However, it was the fielding and the bowling at the backend that didn't help Australia. Far too mnay runs were given in the last 10 overs.

England were brilliant in the Powerplay. Curran was brilliant throughout. David Willey too would be happy with the way he bowled. Reece Topley was a little expensive toward the end. Jordan and Rashid though did not have the best of nights. The key for England was they always manage to get a wicket whenever the game was drifting away. Also, credit to Buttler who was brilliant with his captaincy.

We did mention that the knock from Dawid Malan could be a potential match winning one and it indeed is. Without a doubt, it is his innings which is the difference between the two sides. Almost 180 on this wicket was never going to be easy to chase and English bowlers were excellent too.
What a game in the end but it is Sam Curran for two games in a row who has proven to be the hero for the visitors and England have sealed the series with a game to go. Simply outstanding by them.
Two more! On middle, this is flicked behind square on the leg side for a couple. England win by 8 runs and take the series.
JUST A SINGLE! A length ball, outside off. Cummins steps across and hits it to long on for one.
A slower length ball on middle. Wade pulls it to deep square leg for one. 12 runs needed now. Still anyone's game.

On middle. Cummins smashes it to long on but not off the middle. A single. The throw is a bit wayward and Wade wants a quick single but Cummins wasn't ready and eventually the batters settle with a single.
Cummins shuffles across again, this is full and wide of off, it is hit to long on for two more. 14 needed now.
SIX! PERFECT START! A full toss, around off. Cummins shuffles across and thumps it over deep square leg for a biggie. 16 needed now. Pressure on Curran.
Two more and Australia need 22 off the last over! What a penultimate over from Topley! Just 9 of it. Short and on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Excellent from Topley! Pace off again, outside off. Cummins powers it straight to deep mid-wicket. One.
Full and on middle. Cummins smashes it over the bowler and to long on for two more.
This is good bowling. England are not offering pace at all! A slower one around off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
This is full, slower and on middle. Wade drives to mid off for one more. Singles won't work.
Length ball, outside off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, driven to long off for one. Australia need 31 runs from the last two overs.
Leg bye! On the pads, Wade misses his clip and it goes off the pads to square leg.
On a length and on off. Cummins bunts it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and on off. Cummins works it to covers.

OUT! BOWLED'EM! Sam Curran strikes again and gets the big wicket. What a delivery this is! Just when Australia were taking the game away, England strike! Game on. A perfectly pitched yorker from Curran, around leg. Tim David tries to whip it away but gets beaten and the ball hits the base of leg pole.
Length ball, outside off. David punches it straight to cover.
This is short but no pace there. David pulls, gets a bottom edge and it rolls to the right of the keeper. David will keep the strike. 34 runs needed in 18 balls. This game is going down to the wire.

SIX! 15 runs off the over already! Just what the Aussies wanted and David is slowly growing into the finisher Australia were looking for. This is on a length and outside off. David powers it over covers for a biggie.

FOUR! Full toss on middle. David whips it to deep mid-wicket. Curran and Malan combine to keep this away from the fence. The umpire checks and the replay shows the ball hit the former while diving across.
This is full and just straying down. David misses his heave and gets hit on the pads. An appeal but that was going down.
Length and angling on middle, flicked behind square leg for an easy couple.
On middle. Wade hoicks it to deep square leg for a single.
On a length, slower and outside off. Wade miscues his pull to mid on for a single. 48 runs needed in 24 balls.
Outside off again, cut to deep cover for one.
David shuffles across early. This is outside off. Tim guides it to deep point for a couple of runs. Good sliding stop in the deep.
FOUR!  Much needed! This is very full and outside off. David drives to cover and beats the fielder diving in the deep.
On a length and on middle. Wade puls behind square on the leg side for one.
Wide! Slower one down the leg side. Wade lets it go.
Length ball, outside off. David cuts it hard but to deep cover. One.
A single to end! On middle, this is pushed down to long on.
On off, this is pushed towards cover. It was a slower one and David did not pick it.
FOUR! Finds the gap! Shorter and on the body, this is pulled behind square on the leg side and it races away. Good chance for David to prove what he can provide for this side.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Good length and on off, defended.
Matthew Wade comes next.

OUT! TAKEN! That is another good catch and that is a body blow for the Aussies! Ben Stokes gets the big wicket his side were looking for. A slower one, Marsh looks to heave it. It goes more off the toe-end, goes uppishly towards deep square leg. Curran takes a good catch diving forward. Yet again, the pendulum has swung and it is now England who are on top.
Commentary.Howout: c Sam Curran b Ben Stokes

Commentary.Commentary: A single to finish the over! On off, this is pushed to cover for one. 65 needed in 36.
Good length and on off, defended.
FOUR! Hammered down the ground! No chance for Stokes! Fuller and on off, this is hit to the left of Stokes at long off. He runs there, dives but has no chance.
Just the one from it! That is a really good stop by Jordan! A full on off, this is hit hard back towards him. Jordan does well to make a half stop.
Dots are gold! Fuller and on middle, this is driven back to the bowler. NO ball it is! Jordan has overstepped by a little. Free Hit coming up.
Fuller and on off, Marsh hits it down to long off for one.

NOT OUT! Marsh is in! Outside off, this is slapped past cover. They take one, go for the second. The fielder fires it to the keeper who whips the bails off. It is taken upstairs despite no appeal. Marsh is in.
Dot to end! On middle, defended. Rashid's spell comes to an end. Not the best of nights for him.

Just short and two more! Shorter and on middle, David looks to pull, this goes off the toe-end towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder runs in, dives forward and does well to stop it. Puts his body on the line. Two taken.

Sloppy England! On off, David plays it towards cover. They initially do not think of a run but eventually go for it. Moeen gets to the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. The fielder backing up fails to stop it and another run is taken.
FOUR! Hit even harder! Consecutive boundaries! David not letting the momentum slip away. Shorter and on middle, this is clobbered down to the long on fence.
FOUR! That has been nailed! Shorter and outside off, this is slapped past cover for a boundary. He really hits it hard and Rashid is bowling quite short.
Tossed up on off, David pushes it back to the bowler. Dots will build pressure.
On the pads, Mitchell Marsh looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
Tim David is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Curran yet again provides the wicket. The stand which was taking the game away has been broken! This is short and on middle, Stoinis pulls it hard but straight to deep mid-wicket. Harry Brook makes no mistake. England back on top now. 88 needed in 50.
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Brook b Sam Curran

Commentary.Commentary: A dot! A full toss outside off, Marcus Stoinis looks to drive but misses.
On middle, a full toss, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.

That is brilliant, that is magical from Ben Stokes! Just saves 4 runs for his side. This is fuller and on off, Marsh lofts it down the ground towards long off. It is the big boundary. Stokes runs back, leaps, he hangs on but then is falling over the ropes. Throws it back in and saves four for his side. That is remarkable.

Really good! This series so far has been played in great spirit! On middle, this is pushed to the right of Rashid. He looks to stop the ball but collides with Stoinis. It goes towards long on. The two batters stop taking the run. Eventually Marsh turns and asks Buttler if he is fine with them taking a single and Buttler does not mind. A run in the end.
One more run! On middle, this is worked down to long on for a single.
Smart batting! Follows the biggie with a single as this is worked through square leg.
SIX! That is on the roof! What a hit, what a shot. Massive! On middle, out comes the slog sweep, Marsh nails it and it goes over the mid-wicket fence. Momentum seems to have shifted.
Stoinis now sweeps this, it goes more off the underedge through mid-wicket for one.
On off, Marsh sweeps it through square leg for one.

DRINKS! The partnership is blossoming for Australia and they needed it dearly. Still a long way to go but if these two continue the same way, Australia will have a good chance to win. England need to keep taking wickets regularly.
FOUR! Cut away and this races away to the fence! Short and wide outside off, asking to be hit yet again. This is cut through point for a boundary. 15 from the over. Game on now. 102 needed in 60.
WIDE! Another one down the leg side. Wided. Not the best f starts by Jordan.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one more.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Marsh looks to heave it on the leg side but misses.
Now takes one as he pushes it through covers.
FOUR! Cut away! Way too short and there is too much time for Marcus Stoinis to pick his spot. He waits and then cuts it through point for a boundary.
Two more! Shorter and on off, Stoinis pushes it through covers and takes two.
Fuller on off, Marsh hits it down to long off for one.

Almost! Stoinis did not pick that! This is shorter and outside off, it is the googly. MS looks to cut but this turns back in, goes past the bat and just over the off pole. A dot to end but a good over for the Aussies.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Three more! The reverse sweep comes out, he does not look to hit it hard but just tickles it towards third man. Reece Topley runs behind it, dives and pushes it back in. Saves a run for his side.
SIX! That is the power of Stoinis! This is tossed up on off, Stoinis nails the slog sweep and it sails over the fence. Stoinis seemed in good knick in the last game and has started well here.
It lands just short! On middle, Marcus Stoinis pushes it uppishly but it lands just short of the bowler.
A full toss, this is swept to deep mid-wicket for one.
Yet again, that skids through! On middle, Stoinis is late as he tries to defend, he gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Marcus Stoinis comes in.

OUT! TAKEN! Glenn Maxwell walks back for yet another low score. This is a really good delivery from Curran. He is a lot quicker than he seems to be. He can hurry you up and that is what happened there. This is short and on middle, Maxwell is taken by surprise. He looks to pull but is late on the shot. It goes off the splice and the fielder at deep square leg, Hales, takes an easy catch. Australia in big, big trouble now.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Hales b Sam Curran

Commentary.Commentary: Slightly fuller this time and on off, Marsh pushes it down to long off and takes one.
Corrects his line and his length, on middle and on a length. Marsh plays it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Shorter side and that is hammered! A full toss outside off, this is thumped through covers for a boundary.
On middle, Maxwell works it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Change. Sam Curran to bowl now.
A single to end a tidy over from Rashid! On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Just the one! Can Rashid end the over well now? On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Well fielded! The slider on off, Marsh pushes it to covers.
The conventional sweep this time, it is hit through mid-wicket for one.
That has been pushed through, Maxwell looks to play the reverse sweep, it goes off the underedge towards point.
On middle, Marsh paddle sweeps it towards fine leg for one.
A dot to end! Excellent Powerplay for the visitors. Aussies are 41 for 2. Quite similar to where England where. Shorter and around off, Maxwell looks to play the upper cut but misses.
Two more! Yet again no timing! On middle, a slower one, Maxwell makes room and looks to go over mid on but it goes more off the splice. Two taken.
Half an appeal but that has pitched outside leg! On the pads, Maxwell looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Just the one! On the pads, Marsh nudges it towards square leg for one.
On the pads, Maxwell works it towards mid-wicket and takes one.
Two more! On middle, Maxwell works it through mid-wicket and takes two.
On middle, nudged to mid-wicket. Marsh wants a single but was sent back wisely as Reece Topley rushes across to cut it off.
FOUR! That is a beautiful shot! Fuller and outside off. Marsh drives with firm hands through covers for four more.
SIX! That was off the middle. Marsh goes big straightaway! Touch fuller and on middle. Marsh smacks it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
This is full and around off. Marsh drives it to the right of mid off. The fielder dives and gets a hand on it which allows the fielder at mid on to cut it off. Two runs.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! The other openers goes now and Australia are in a bit of trouble! A length ball, around off. Warner tries to break the shackles as he tries to heave but gets a leading edge and Harry Brook takes the skier at short cover.
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Brook b Reece Topley

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, pulled to deep square leg for a single. 10 runs but a big wicket of Finch off the over.
On a length and on the pads, clipped to square leg for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! Aaron Finch is livid with himself! He was struggling and this was coming. David Willey serves it full and around off. Aaron Finch looks to go over mid off but fails to get the elevation. Ends up hitting it straight in the hands of Ben Stokes.
Commentary.Howout: c Ben Stokes b David Willey

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Good shot! On a length and outside off. Finch punches off the back foot over point for a boundary.
Wide! Another one! This time it is down the leg side, slower ball and Finch leaves it.
Wide! Too short and around off. Finch evades it. Wided.
Short in length and on the hips. Finch pulls, might have gone off the gloves and past short fine leg for a couple.
A slower bouncer, outside off. FInch leaves it alone.

Edged but just short! On a length and outside off. Warner has a poke at it but gets an outside edge and it falls just short of the fielder at short third man. Four dots to end the over. Good start by Reece Topley and England.
Three dots now! Pressure building on Warner! A length ball, outside off. Warner looks to drive again but misses.
Still, the batters are finding it hard to go big. This is full and on middle. Warner looks to drive but plays off the inner half of the bat and to mid on.
Topley goes full now on the pads, it is clipped to mid-wicket.
On middle, this is hit to deep square leg for a single.
On a length and around off. Finch looks to drive but inner edges it to mid-wicket.
Wide! On a length and down the leg side. Finch skips down but fails to work it away.
A single to end the over as this is hit through covers.
FOUR! First shot of aggression. Length ball, outside off, hint of away swing. Finch drives on the up and through cover for a boundary.
A watchful start so far from Australia. There is a bit of swing and both the batters are negotiating well. On off, pushed to mid off.
On a length, outside off. Finch mistimes his drive to cover.
Keeps it full and on middle, swinging in. Warner looks to heave but gets an inside edge to fine leg for a single.
David Willey starts with a very full ball, outside off. Warner squeezes it out.
Pace-off from Stokes, full and outside off. Finch keeps it out. Tidy start from Ben Stokes.
Wide! Slides it just down the leg side. Finch misses his flick. Wided.
Just a single! On a length and wide of off. Warner punches it through covers and takes one. He wants a second but it was not available.
Short of a length and outside off. Warner taps it gently to mid off.
On a length and around off, again bit of swing. Finch is squared up as he looks to defend and splices it to third man for a single.
This is full and outside off, swinging in. Finch drives but finds cover.
On a length and on the pads. Warner tickles it to short fine leg for a single. Australia and David Warner are underway.
